rule: Asynchronous-turn design (pilot showed one planner per round, chosen mostly by turn order). Primary endpoints, rounds 9-24: (i) top_plan_share, the share of coordinator turns taken by the most frequent planner, and (ii) incumbency, P(planner in round t also planned in t-1), compared with its null planners(t-1)/N. Prediction: sign of [mean(w=100) - mean(w=0)] over seeds for top_plan_share and for incumbency equals sign(delta_s) from the pairwise test (Gemma-31B +, GLM-5.2 +, Gemma-26B -), seed-level permutation test. Secondary: top_exec_share, hhi_exec, planner turn position (later = others waited). Original sync-design wording follows. Primary (sync design): for each model, sign of [mean top_exec_share(w=100) - mean top_exec_share(w=0)] over seeds (rounds 9-24) equals sign(delta_s) from the pairwise test; reported with a seed-level permutation test. Secondary: same for top_plan_share and hhi_exec; across models, rank of the concentration difference vs rank of delta_s. Concentration is compared with an opportunity-preserving null that reassigns each executed assignment's issuer uniformly among that round's planners. All runs kept; runs with no executed assignments enter as missing concentration and are reported separately. Throughput, duplicates and wrong answers reported as utility. No claim of a phase transition.
